title: A track call 4 s after the hook prompt it copies

records.why: A hook prompt that passes SM 2.2 rule 6, substantive, lead 120 + 150 / 1.5 = 220 s. Level B: presence from input_any only (6.4).

DESIGN 5.4: pairtime sees the session through hooks and a log reader, and the call comes 4 s after the session's hook prompt, within TRACK_DEDUPE_S = 30 s: track_matched. It opens nothing, resets nothing and fills nothing; it feeds the compliance counter. Never counts toward logged_s (D19).
The Bash call that ran pairtime track, from the PostToolUse hook: an agent event, so it counts toward logged_s and ai_logged_s. No output lines, so it fills nothing.
The answer from the transcript: 120 words fill 40 s. Not one of SM 5.4's agent events (prompt submits, tool calls, agent edits, stops), and it shares the stop's millisecond.
The Stop hook: an agent event, counted in both series.

turns.why: SM 2.4: the 20 s base, then 60 * 120 / 180 = 40 s for the answer. Hooks and the transcript back the turn, so no side-door cap applies, and the track call starts no turn.

notes: A wrong scorer that opened an anchor for the call would reset the bucket at 14:04:44 and credit the drain after it at level C, the level of the nearest anchor (DESIGN 6.4).
